neighbours.label: ' of' after a noun of manner or regularity ('style of', 'pattern of'): naming the kind of thing a style or pattern belongs to
fire: The painter developed a bold style of portrait that critics loved.
Doctors noticed a worrying pattern of weight loss in the patients.
He is famous for his relaxed style of guitar playing.
The data show a clear pattern of growth in the north.
The architect created a new style of public housing.
Teachers reported a pattern of missing homework among the boys.
She has her own style of cooking that mixes old recipes.
Researchers found a strange pattern of spikes in the signal.
